1e55fa4e-00b7-4c85-9842-6c7737ec369f.quote: Mr_Meat31 covered Phase's full meta core (Marshal, Enra's Blessing, Galaxy Greaves), including Enra's Blessing's shield for an immobilized ally within range — real value against Riktor's pull-into-silence-into-suppress chain. The last three slots went to Prophecy, Plasma Blade, and Spectra, three on-hit or ability-power items built for more damage rather than survivability. Against a comp with roughly three seconds of chainable hard crowd control, the alternative path, a defensive item with built-in tenacity like Unbroken Will, would have helped Phase survive the suppress instead of adding damage from a hero who finished with zero kills. The trade mattered most given Phase died in all three fights reached this game.

1e55fa4e-00b7-4c85-9842-6c7737ec369f.quote: The engine's top-modeled major for Phase support is Vesh, an ability-damage blessing that adds a damage tick to her spells — it lines up with a passive that already heals off ability casts, letting Phase chip health while sustaining herself and a linked ally. The default minors add haste on takedowns and bonus damage against high-health targets, leaning the loadout toward extended teamfights rather than one burst window. The trade-off is that Vesh spends its budget on damage, not survivability, so a Phase running it still needs the item slots, not the blessing, to answer a chain-crowd-control comp like this one.
